newsitem.title: FRANCE: Police, Jews scuffle in Paris over Israel bomb.
newsitem.headline: Police, Jews scuffle in Paris over Israel bomb.

text.p: Police scuffled on Wednesday with members of a French rightist Jewish youth group which tried to break into the Paris office of the Palestinian Authority to protest against a bloody bomb attack in Jerusalem, both sides said.
There were no arrests or serious injuries though both sides accused the other of using tear gas.

A spokesman for the Betar movement said police threw tear gas at them and chased them with clubs after the demonstration which included prayers and calls for massive Jewish settlement on the West Bank and Gaza Strip.
Police said one of the 60 demonstrators sprayed tear gas into the eyes of an officer who was taken to hospital. They denied using tear gas themselves.
